rules.spacingMethod: Reviewed scanline optical-pair proposals, bounded -60/+45 units; pairs retain at least 95 units of common-height ink separation.

hDesign.rightStroke: Near-vertical lower stroke with a short angled terminal; no sweeping hook.
hDesign.relationship: Shoulder below the top of the lowercase t crossbar.

strokeFamilies.method: Current capitalOpticalWeight governs capitals around190-200, retaining I and thin returns; lowercase about260 with lowercaseShoulders correction.
strokeFamilies.limitations: Scanline widths guide matching uprights and bowls; diagonal normal widths and joins need separate optical inspection.

bodyHeightDesign.method: Shorten the middle body zone while initially retaining the lower and upper 250-unit terminal bands. Keep ascender caps above 1400 and descenders fixed. Apply the subsequent lowercase width and counter refinement recorded below.
bodyHeightDesign.accentPolicy: Translate marks with the lowered base rather than compressing them.
bodyHeightDesign.counterRefinement: Lowercase horizontal reach reduced 7%, retaining sidebearings; matching principal stems now about 260 units against capitals about 270. Closed body counters opened vertically by 50–80 units without moving outer body/ascender/descender edges.

capitalOpticalWeight.method: Further optical capital correction from revision 8: most principal stems200, dominant A/N/K/T190; preserve I and already-thin diagonal returns. No additional counter expansion or lowercase change.

lowercaseShoulders.method: Translate upper shoulder contours, taper to zero below height 300; preserve baseline, x coordinates and advances. The left w tip already meets the body line.
